SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
S. S. D. REGISTER
D 2757
20/6/32

June 29 32.

G. B. McIntyre, Esq.,
28 Leinster St.,
Saint John,
New Brunswick,
Canada.

Dear Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
dated May 21, 1932, and to state that no trace can
be found of Harold Knowlton who does not seem to
have ever visited Shanghai.

Yours faithfully,

Assistant Commissioner (Special Branch)
for Commissioner of Police,

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. File No. REGISTRY
No. D 3757
Special Branch - B. Station.
Date 29 / 6 / 32
June 29. 19 32）

Subject (in full) Whereabouts of Harold Knowlton.

Made by D.P.S. Pitts. Forwarded by SSG Luerst.

With reference to the attached letter, dated May
21, 1932, addressed to the Commissioner of Police
from one G.B.McIntyre of St. John, New Brunswick,
regarding the whereabouts of the writer's cousin
Harold Knowlton, I have to state that exhaustive
enquiries in all directions have failed to locate the
whereabouts of this person.
All avenues in Shanghai through which Knowlton
might have passed, either as a passenger or as a
member of a ship's crew, have been carefully and
diligently explored with abortive results.
No local shipping company has any record of
the name "Harold Knowlton" during the past twelve
months and the result of investigations indicate
that the person in question has not passed through
Shanghai during that period.
Further enquiries will be made and should any
information regarding Knowlton be forthcoming, an
additional report will be submitted.

（批：JK）

sa Pitts
D. P. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Mr Yao, Please acknowledge
and say we are unable to
trace Knowlton who does not
appear to have ever visited
Shanghai.
JH

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. 档案编号 登记处
编号 D 3757
特别股 - B 巡捕房。
日期 1932 年 6 月 29 日
1932 年 6 月 29 日）

事由（全称）：Harold Knowlton 的下落。

由警司 Pitts 呈报。经警佐 Luerst 转呈。

关于附函所述，1932 年 5 月 21 日，来自新不伦瑞克省圣约翰市的 G.B. McIntyre 致警务处处长一信，查询其表亲 Harold Knowlton 之下落，本人谨此声明，经多方详尽查访，未能查明此人之下落。
对于 Knowlton 可能经过的所有渠道，无论是作为乘客还是船员，均已仔细勤勉地进行了排查，但均无结果。
过去十二个月内，本地任何轮船公司均无“Harold Knowlton”之姓名记录，调查结果表明，该人在此期间并未经过上海。
将继续进行进一步查访，若有关于 Knowlton 的任何消息，将另行提交报告。

（批注：JK）

sa Pitts
警司
特别股主管警官。

（批注：姚先生，请复函告知我方无法追踪到 Knowlton，此人似乎从未到过上海。
JH
6月29日：83。）
